statement: SDL's feature 0x03 capabilities probe with expected 48-byte response and marker 0x28 in data[2] gates *third-party PlayStation detection*, then extracts flags such as sensor/LED/rumble; Sony PID path assumes core capabilities instead. Source inspection gives no evidence that Sony 054c:0ce6 requires OpenPuck's synthetic 0x03 capabilities response to enumerate as DualSense.

applicability.revision: source revisions: Linux 4056b3c, SDL 535d80b/829a65d, HHD adbd50f and community pinned commits; physical firmware unknown
applicability.scope: SDL 535d80b 297-320, 435-457; 829a65d detection path. No proof what an individual Steam build queries; copying an emulator's 0x03 cannot substitute for physical spec.
